descriptions.zh:
随着这些权利在刚刚的[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]议案中通过，我们同时要求工人们承担更多的责任。

我们现在可以鼓励失业工人自行迁移到我们控制的其他拥有足够住房，岗位的宜居星球。
descriptions.en:
Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.

We can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have available housing, jobs, and are of adequate habitability.

descriptions.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予工作子个体更多权限的法规。

尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了转运空闲简单子个体而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
descriptions.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their worker drones.

While this is largely meaningless to us, we can at least benefit from some of the infrastructure they have created in order to resettle inactive simple drones.

descriptions.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予劳工更多权益的法规。

尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了安置空闲子个体和劳工们而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
descriptions.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their workers.

While this ruling is largely meaningless to us, we can derive some token benefit from the infrastructure they created for resettling their own inactive drones and laborers.

descriptions.zh:
只有通过考古论证和想象才能在如今已经荒芜的[From.Planet.GetName]表面上重构出那个曾经繁盛一时的文明。岁月的流逝是残酷无情的，即使是曾经最为坚不可摧的建筑，如今也只化作一地的尘埃。

但在那深不可测的地下，有一个怪异的信号正在脉动着。一座神秘的信标仿佛呼唤着我们的调查和发掘。
descriptions.en:
Only through archaeological proof and imagination can one depict a once flourishing civilization on the now desolate surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. So unkind has the passage of time been, that even the sturdiest buildings have been grinded down to little more than dust.

But from deep underground a strange signal is pulsing. A mysterious beacon yearning for investigation and uncovering.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
当挖掘团队越来越接近深处的信标时，无法忽视的死亡感触突然神秘地在挖掘团队中蔓延。随着更多的泥土和石头被清除，一个坚定的观念在每个人的脑海中徘徊：

生命转瞬即逝。总有一天这一切都会结束……
descriptions.en:
A sudden and undeniable sense of mortality has mysteriously crept upon the excavation team as they get closer to the beacon in the depths. As more dirt and rock is removed, an unescapable notion lingers in the back of everyone's mind:

Life is fleeting. Someday all this is going to end...

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
信号来源是一座外星墓碑，上面镌刻着奇异的符号。翻译文本充其量只算是略有眉目。这些符号提及了一位举足轻重的人物，其一生的伟业值得铭记与崇拜，整个文明都处于哀伤之中。翻译文本接近末尾时变得十分怪异，诉说体液因悲伤从身体中流出，随后又因天气条件而消逝。

只有全文的最后一部分得到了成功翻译：

§H‘死亡的时刻到了。’§!
descriptions.en:
The source of the signal is an alien tombstone inscribed with strange symbols. The translation is sketchy at best. It speaks of a person of great importance, of a life's work worthy of remembrance and veneration, and of a civilization in mourning. Towards the end the translation becomes very odd, speaking of grief-induced leakage of bodily-fluids, and their subsequent dissipation due to weather conditions.

Only the very last part was successfully translated:

§H'Time to die.'§!

descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]地表的初步探索揭示了这颗行星曾经确实是某个文明的家园。

然而，荒芜的程度表明这个文明的存在已经是非常非常久的时间以前的事情了，而且它极有可能曾经遭受到某种突然且可怖的力量袭击。残余的废墟还不足以提供关于这种外星人的生理学信息。
descriptions.en:
Initial exploration down on [From.Planet.GetName]'s surface reveals that this planet was indeed home to some kind of civilization.

However, the level of devastation indicates that it must've been very long ago, and it's quite likely that the civilization was struck by some kind of sudden and terrifying force. There isn't even ruins enough left to get an idea about the aliens' physiology.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
地表探测团队从行星上分离出一条无线电信号。其发信源仍暂时未知，不过已被破译的部分则已经可以开始向我们讲述这个失落已久的文明的故事了。

某种未知的威胁步步逼近这个文明；对技术的进步陷入了集体的沉迷；传言称在星系的其他地方正在建造一艘硕大无朋的宇宙战舰。这些主题在这些杂乱无章的信息里反复地出现。
descriptions.en:
The surface team has isolated a radio signal down on the planet. Its origin is still unknown, but translated parts have started to reveal information about the long lost civilization:

Some unidentified and approaching threat to the civilization. A collective fascination with technological advances. Rumours of a giant spaceship being built in another part of the galaxy. These themes are recurring in the scrambled messages.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
考古学家们设法抵达了这个神秘信号的来源——深藏于地面之下。

刚刚开始不久的遗址发掘工作，就已经表明这似乎是某种研发设施。这个地方到处都是高度微缩的多种科学设备原型。

扫描发现在其下还有一个空洞，发掘正在进行当中。
descriptions.en:
The archaeologists managed to home in the source of the mysterious signal. It came from deep underground.

Unearthing of the site has only just begun, but indications point to some kind of research and development facility. The place is littered with remarkably high-detail miniature prototypes of various technological devices.

Scans show a hollow space further down, and excavation is underway.

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的发掘小组有了一个有意思的发现。一组硬盘，里面记录的是作为该设施的核心焦点乃至他们整个文明核心焦点的某个持续运作的项目信息。

据描述，这是一艘§H能与星系间最庞大飞船相抗衡的巨大舰船§!。

他们在这里到底在建造一个什么样的巨大怪物？
descriptions.en:
Our excavation team have made an interesting discovery. A collection of miniature hard drives held information about an ongoing project that seems to have been the focal point of this installation, maybe even that of the entire civilization.

It speaks of a §Hmighty vessel to rival the galaxy's most gargantuan flyer§!.

What beast of a machine did they build down here?

options.script:
name = DIG
small_artifact_reward = yes

descriptions.zh:
这是一艘“巨大”的宇宙飞船！

好吧，事实证明，至少对于从前[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民来说，这艘飞船其实还蛮大的。那些我们在这里找到的微缩原型机正是飞船本身的机器，而原以为是某种设备的东西，其实是他们的首都。至于在加密信号里提到的“威胁”，实际上是一场太空技术竞赛里的对手。这个微型文明全体聚集至此则是为了尽全力夺取冠军。

不过好像我们才是这次竞赛的获奖者。
descriptions.en:
It's a massive spaceship!

Well, at least to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who - as it turned out - were absolutely tiny. The miniature prototypes found here were apparently their actual machines, and what was assumed to be a facility, was in fact their capitol city. The 'threat' that was mentioned in the scrambled signals turned out to be their opponents in an intergalactic tech competition. This entire mini-civilization came together trying to get the first prize!

Seems as if we are the ones to score the prize this time.

options.script:
name = SPLENDID
small_artifact_reward = yes
create_lesser_messenger = yes

descriptions.zh:
一艘巨大的宇宙飞船被我们发现了！

其实只是对于原先[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民而言这艘飞船很大，因为他们这个物种十分微小。

由于畏惧某种神秘的威胁降临他们的母星，他们整个族群都聚集至此以建造一艘宇宙飞船来应对这迫在眉睫的威胁。

看上去他们还是晚了一步；毕竟他们的攻击舰还留在原地，可他们自己却消失无踪了。
descriptions.en:
A massive space ship have been discovered!

Or at least it was massive to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who turned out to be a minuscule species.

Fearing a mysterious threat approaching their homeworld, the entire species came together to build a space ship that could take on the impending terror.

They appear to have been too late; their assault ship is still here, but they're not.

options.script:
name = SPLENDID
small_artifact_reward = yes
create_lesser_messenger = yes

descriptions.zh:
真是一艘宏伟的宇宙飞船啊！

一艘宏伟，却又特别小巧的宇宙飞船。这说明[From.Planet.GetName]上的原住民其实是一种微型物种。我们遇到的微缩物件其实是他们的机器，而这个损坏的设备则曾经是一座主要城市。

在听说星系另一端有人建造了一艘庞大的宇宙飞船后，这些生物决定也建造一艘飞船来比肩那个庞然大物。

真是了不得的决心与勇气，当然了，也捎带着一点可爱。
descriptions.en:
It's a grand space ship!

A grand, absolutely tiny space ship. As it turns out the population of [From.Planet.GetName] was a mini-species. The miniatures encountered were their actual machines, and this ruined facility was once a major city.

Having heard of a space ship of great proportions being built in another part of the galaxy, this species decided to build a ship to match the alien behemoth.

It shows great determination and courage. It's also a little bit cute.

options.script:
name = SPLENDID
small_artifact_reward = yes
create_lesser_messenger = yes

descriptions.zh:
威震寰宇的主宰已经建成。

这艘行动自如的庞然巨舰将彻底改变进攻作战的范式。它可以在前线建造和维修舰船，并配有足以摧枯拉朽的火力，使我们得以不间断地攻击那些敢与我们作对的人。

如今只有蠢货才会对抗[Owner.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
The construction of the impressive Juggernaut has been completed.

This mobile behemoth changes the paradigm of offensive warfare entirely. It can construct and repair ships on the frontline, and is equipped with devastating firepower, allowing for a ceaseless assault of those who dare stand against us.

Only fools will oppose [Owner.GetName] now.

options.script: name = fedev.9500.a

descriptions.zh:
经确认，§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!已经完成了巨型主宰舰的建造。这一行动自如的太空基地装配了海量火力，并能在作战前线建造和维护舰船，使其在任何作战场景下都是更严峻的威胁。

这真的是太空战里的尖端军备。
descriptions.en:
It has been verified that §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! has finished the construction of a massive Juggernaut ship. This mobile space base packs extensive firepower and is able to build and maintain ships at the frontline of battle, making it a superior threat in any combat scenario.

It is truly the apex armament of space war.

label.zh: 有点改变战争规则的意思了。
label.en: Bit of a game changer, that one.

options.script: name = fedev.9505.a

descriptions.zh:
让历史铭记这一天，§H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§!与§H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§!政府签署了一个联邦条约，作为§H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的共同缔造者，他们将携手并肩面对未来。

这个新的星系联合将作为一个光辉的榜样，告诉星系里的其他人，所有的一切都可以通过共同努力来实现。

星际外交的新时代已经开始了!
descriptions.en:
Let history record that on this day, the governments of the §H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§! and the §H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§! signed a treaty of federation. As founding members of the §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, they will now face the future as firm allies.

This new Galactic Union will serve as an shining example to the rest of the galaxy of all that can be accomplished by working together.

A new era of interstellar diplomacy has begun!

descriptions.zh:
让历史铭记这一天，§H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§!与§H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§!政府签署了一个联邦条约，作为§H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的共同缔造者，他们将携手并肩面对未来。

新的贸易联盟将会毫无疑问的给我们所有的成员带来经济繁荣。

新的星际商业时代来临了！
descriptions.en:
Let history record that on this day, the governments of the §H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§! and the §H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§! signed a treaty of federation. As founding members of the §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, they will now face the future as firm allies.

This new Trade League will no doubt bring about economic prosperity for all of its members.

A new era of interstellar commerce has begun!

descriptions.zh:
让历史铭记这一天，§H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§!与§H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§!政府签署了一个联邦条约，作为§H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的共同缔造者，他们将携手并肩面对未来。

这个研究联合组织将给我们所有成员的科学家以新机会来联合我们的知识。

科学进步的好时代来临了！
descriptions.en:
Let history record that on this day, the governments of the §H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§! and the §H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§! signed a treaty of federation. As founding members of the §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, they will now face the future as firm allies.

This Research Cooperative will provide the scientists of all its member states with new opportunities to pool their knowledge.

A new era of technological advancement has begun!

descriptions.zh:
让历史铭记这一天，§H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§!与§H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§!政府签署了一个联邦条约，作为§H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的共同缔造者，他们将携手并肩面对未来。

这一军事同盟的联合力量肯定会使那些企图在其成员国领土上搞阴谋的人踌躇不前。

一个军事霸权的新时代已经开始了!
descriptions.en:
Let history record that on this day, the governments of the §H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§! and the §H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§! signed a treaty of federation. As founding members of the §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, they will now face the future as firm allies.

The combined might of this Martial Alliance is sure to give pause to those with designs on the territory of its member states.

A new era of military supremacy has begun!

descriptions.zh:
让历史铭记这一天，§H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§!与§H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§!政府签署了一个联邦条约，作为§H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的共同缔造者，他们将携手并肩面对未来。

这种霸权主义将通过其统治霸权的开明领导确保其下级成员的安全。

一个[fed_founder_1.GetSpeciesName]霸权的新时代来临了！
descriptions.en:
Let history record that on this day, the governments of the §H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§! and the §H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§! signed a treaty of federation. As founding members of the §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, they will now face the future as firm allies.

This grand Hegemony will ensure the safety of its junior members through the enlightened leadership of its ruling Hegemon.

A new era of [fed_founder_1.GetSpeciesName] dominance has begun!

titles.zh: 即将进行的试点：物流重构

descriptions.zh:
各种货物的运输路线是我们贸易联邦兴旺繁荣的生命线。但迄今为止，各帝国仍在容器设计、装载程序及运输管道等方面采用各自的物流标准。

为了使效率最大化，一个新的试点项目将在几年后实施——项目目标是调研并试验一种全新、具体，适用于联邦所有成员国的运输标准。

参与试点需要拥有一个至少有§H50点贸易额§!流经的恒星系。此外，设有§H外星贸易公司§!意味着更高的统计数据，所以应对其进行鼓励。

由于项目所涉范围广泛，一些开销必不可少。但这些牺牲是为了长远的利益。换句话说，也就是更多的未来利润。

联邦各成员国均被强烈鼓励参与项目。
descriptions.en:
The routing of various goods is the life-blood of our prosperous trade federation. But so far each empire has relied on their own logistic standards with regards to container design, loading procedures, and shipping pipelines.

In order to maximize efficiency, a new trial project will commence in a few years - one that aims to investigate and trial a new, specific shipping standard that would be applied to all members of the federation.

Participation requires a system with at least §H50 Trade§! flowing through it. Furthermore, the existence of an §HOffworld Trading Company§! would mean increased statistical data, and so is encouraged.

Due to the vast scope of this project, some costs will apply. But it's for the greater good. That is to say: more future profit.

Every member of the federation is strongly encouraged to participate.

descriptions.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，§Y[From.GetName]§!已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘§H工程船§!，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。

我们还拥有一处§H外星贸易公司§!设施，正因如此，项目进度有所加快。公司所属的帝国将获得一些金融优待，以表感激。
descriptions.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, §Y[From.GetName]§! has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a §HConstruction Ship§! must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.

An §HOffworld Trading Company§! facility is also available, and thanks to this, the project will be expedited. The empire will be granted some financial leniency as a token of gratitude.

descriptions.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，§Y[From.GetName]§!已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘§H工程船§!，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。

我们没有§H外星贸易公司§!。这不会阻止我们参与试点，但会在一定程度上妨碍项目进度，因为我们无法与所涉各方分享有价值的信息，以便充分对其进行利用。
descriptions.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, §Y[From.GetName]§! has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a §HConstruction Ship§! must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.

An §HOffworld Trading Company§! facility was not available. This doesn't stop our participation, but will impede progress somewhat as we cannot take full advantage of beneficial information-sharing between involved parties.

options.script: name = fedev.615.a

descriptions.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！但是，§Y[From.GetName]§!缺少参与试点所必需的设施。一个拥有充足贸易额流经的恒星系居然没有§H贸易中心§!，真是匪夷所思。

错过有潜在好处的项目算是个错误，但连能带来巨大贸易额的顶级商业机会也会错过？这简直是犯罪！

多么耻辱，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！多么耻辱啊！
descriptions.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! However, §Y[From.GetName]§! has been found lacking in facilities necessary for participation in the trial. The lack of a §HTrade Hub§! in a system with sufficient Trade flowing through it is nothing short of baffling.

To miss out on a potentially beneficial project is a mistake, but to miss out on such a supreme business opportunity as Trade? That's almost a crime!

For shame, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! For shame!

descriptions.zh:
恭喜！重构操作已经结束，专用的贸易中心正按照全新的物流标准运行。除了对这一恒星系进行评估之外，没什么需要做的了。

在试验期结束时，关于试点项目结果的官方声明将会发布。
descriptions.en:
Congratulations! The remodelling operation has finished and the dedicated Trade Hub is now operating to a new logistical standard. Nothing left to do now but to evaluate the new system.

At the end of the trial period there will be an official statement on how the trial project turned out.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
这是就贸易与利润而言意义深远的一天！不仅物流试点成功完成，其结果更是表明星际商业往来更为顺畅，贸易效率显著提升！

结果是，联邦内一切太空贸易操作均会逐步地、不知不觉地切换到新标准进行；整个联邦将由此极大受益。

为利润而欢呼吧！
descriptions.en:
This is a monumental day for profit and trade! Not only is the logistics trial complete, but the results show a noticeable increase in efficiency and smooth interstellar business!

As a result, all space trading operations in the federation will now progressively - and quite unnoticeably - switch over to the new standard; the federation will benefit tremendously.

Hurrah for profit!

descriptions.zh:
这是就贸易与商业而言伟大的一天。试验期已经结束，项目已得到完全评估。我们收集到足够的数据表明贸易效率有所提升，应当全面实施新的物流标准。

现在开始，一切运输操作将逐步切换到新标准——但这个过程是完全自动的。食品会被递送，消费品会被送到它们的目的地，香料仍在运输，如此这般。

总之，干得漂亮！
descriptions.en:
It's a great day for trade and commerce. The trial period is over, and the project has been fully evaluated. Enough data was collected to see an increase in efficiency that warrants full implementation of the new logistical standard.

Now begins a process in which all shipping operations will switch to the new standard - but this process is fully automatic. The foodstuff will be delivered, the consumer goods will reach their destination, the spice will flow, and so on.

Good job!

descriptions.zh:
如果联邦各成员国逐利的动机微弱到这种程度，那灰暗的时代确实来临了。

由于缺乏参与及动力到了令人费解的程度，这项大有前途的物流试点变成了一场闹剧！如今还剩的只有冗长乏味的指责、官司还有诉讼了。

去请个律师吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——会有些不良后果需要处理。
descriptions.en:
Grim times do indeed loom if this is the substandard motivation by which the federation's members pursue profit.

A baffling lack of participation and drive turned this promising logistical trial into nothing short of a farce! Now the only thing that remains is a tedious dance of blame, lawsuits and litigation.

Lawyer up, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there will be repercussions.
